---
applyTo: "native/ui/**"
---

Use Qt C++ Widgets and the accepted snapshot/command API. Keep rendering on the UI thread and simulation work outside it. No vehicle equations, CAN routing, resource scheduler or SHA-256 implementation in widgets. Preserve green/white/charcoal theme, show data age/validity, and label fixtures. Coordinate interfaces through the task board; do not change the core contract unilaterally.
